🇸🇦 Riyadh · Warehouse Marking

Warehouse Marking in Riyadh

Gulf Seismic provides warehouse marking for projects in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Work is planned for local conditions such as extreme dry desert heat and capital and corridor traffic, and is delivered to the project specification — including Riyadh Municipality / MOMRA marking specifications where applicable when the client requires it. Organise floor space, protect workers, and guide forklifts.

Get a Riyadh Quote+966 507 657 243

Warehouse floor marking is the backbone of facility safety and 5S organisation. We apply high-durability epoxy and polyurea line systems that survive forklift traffic, pallet drag and chemical spills. Our layouts separate pedestrians from MHE traffic, mark storage locations, identify hazard zones and create the visual workplace that drives operational efficiency and HSE compliance.

For Riyadh projects, our teams plan application around local conditions (extreme dry desert heat; capital and corridor traffic) and the client's approved specification. Where municipal or transport-authority standards apply, we work to the issued project documents rather than implying blanket approval for every site. Related project examples associated with Riyadh include Riyadh Logistics Hub Warehouse Floor Marking.

Typical outcomes clients seek from warehouse marking include: Forklift-grade durability (epoxy / polyurea); Pedestrian–MHE traffic separation; HSE / OSHA compliant hazard zones. Final scope, materials and programme are confirmed in the quotation.

Our Warehouse Marking process in Riyadh

1

Surface Prep

Grind or shot-blast concrete for adhesion.

2

Layout

Mark pedestrian, forklift and hazard zones to HSE plan.

3

Prime

Apply epoxy primer for chemical bond.

4

Stripe

Apply epoxy or polyurea line system.

5

Cure

Polyurea: 1–2 hrs. Epoxy: 12–24 hrs.
